rows.reason: ARRAY_N is a decided RTL parameter with legal values {4, 8, 16}; a chosen design size, not a measured or sampled quantity.
The INT8 x INT8 -> INT32 signed two's complement format is a decided number format; there is no distribution to characterise.
Output-stationary is a decided architectural choice recorded in decision 0001; it is not a performance figure with spread.
Bank count and size are decided structural values; there is nothing to sample.
The macro port shape (1rw1r, 32-bit word, byte write mask) is a decided interface with its source recorded in decision 0002.
The supported operation set is a decided feature list; presence of an operation is not statistical.
K_MAX is a decided architectural limit, an exact integer bound.
Wishbone B4 classic, 32-bit, slave only is a decided protocol choice, checked by protocol-level testbenches rather than statistics.

The signoff clock is a post-route STA figure bounded per corner by static timing analysis, which is deterministic for a given netlist, parasitics and Liberty views, not a Monte Carlo or distributional result.
Correctness is an exact bit-for-bit comparison against the integer golden model; any mismatch is a failure, so there is no tolerance, yield or statistical spread.
DRC and LVS are deterministic pass/fail checks and STA closure is per-corner; none is a statistical measure.
